text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Yatescastle Drive, between Spenvalley Drive and a point 27 metres south. The proposed prohibition will deter parking in this area during peak school times, improving safety at the intersection.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Yatescastle Drive, between Spenvalley Drive and a point 27 metres south.
